name: Artefact Projects Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1987, Artefact Projects Ltd is engaged in project consultancy business in India[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is an Infrastructure Services Consultancy Organization which provides Engineering, Architectural and Project Management services for Infrastructure Projects viz. Highways, Urban Infrastructure, Airports, Mining Services, and Railways

pros: Stock is trading at 0.67 times its book value
Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 19.7% CAGR over last 5 years
Debtor days have improved from 228 to 149 days.
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -1.19% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.48% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.3.91 Cr.
